description: Write NeuroVue's review outputs without a window: opens a BIDS dataset and/or volumes, applies the given view and clip planes, and writes the same correction patch and review state the interactive neurovue tool saves, plus an optional .nvbundle.

volumes.description: NIfTI volumes to review instead of, or in addition to, a dataset.

match.description: Glob on file names (e.g. *_T1w.nii.gz); only matching volumes are reviewed.

view.description: A NeuroVue BundleViewState (src/domain/bundle.ts), passed through verbatim. Default: the first volume as the base, the rest as overlays, multiplanar.

clip_planes.description: Clip planes for the default view, as NeuroVue saves them. Ignored when view is given.

bundle.description: Also write review.nvbundle (the volumes and the view in one file; can be large).

correction_patch.description: The patch NeuroVue's Save writes, with backend "headless".

review_state.description: The dataset, the reviewed volumes and the view.

review_bundle.description: The volumes and the view as a NeuroVue bundle; only when bundle is true.

block.label: Review in NeuroVue (no window)
block.description: Record a NeuroVue review (view, clip planes, optional bundle) with fixed settings.

requirements: NeuroVue checkout (cdrake/neurovue, main) beside NeuroFlow or via NEUROFLOW_UI_APP_NEUROVUE
cargo (rustup), with neurovue-cli built once: `cargo build --release --features cli --bin neurovue-cli` in src-tauri
neuroflow/launch.description: Runs `cargo run --release --features cli --bin neurovue-cli -- --neuroflow-session $NEUROFLOW_SESSION` in the NeuroVue checkout, after `--check` confirms it is ready. neurovue-cli opens inputs.bids_dir / inputs.volumes without a window and writes correction.patch.json, review.state.json (and review.nvbundle when inputs.bundle is true) to $NEUROFLOW_OUTPUT_DIR, with one review.headless provenance line.

probe.advice: build neurovue-cli once (the probe allows 60 s): `cargo build --release --features cli --bin neurovue-cli` in the checkout's src-tauri

useWhen: An agent or unattended workflow needs NeuroVue's review record (correction patch, review state) for a dataset with nobody at the machine.
Package reviewed volumes and a fixed view as a .nvbundle for someone to open in NeuroVue later.

avoidWhen.when: A person should look at the data and set the view or clip planes themselves.
You need a shareable web page of the volumes, not a NeuroVue review record.

preconditions: A NeuroVue checkout beside NeuroFlow or via NEUROFLOW_UI_APP_NEUROVUE, cargo on PATH or via CARGO, and neurovue-cli built once in release mode. The step runs `neurovue-cli --check` first and stops if it is not ready.
At least one of bids_dir or volumes is given, and match (if any) leaves at least one volume.
effects: Writes correction.patch.json and review.state.json to the output directory, review.nvbundle when bundle is true, and one review.headless provenance line.
Renders nothing: no screenshots or slice previews.

duration.basis: Estimate for a built neurovue-cli: it only reads NIfTI headers unless bundle is true, which copies the volumes. The first run after a source change rebuilds in release mode (minutes).

examples.title: Record a review of a dataset's T1w images
Bundle two volumes for later review

failures.meaning: neurovue-cli --check did not answer: usually it is not built yet, so the probe timed out compiling.
failures.remedy: Run `cargo build --release --features cli --bin neurovue-cli` in the checkout's src-tauri, then retry.
Clone cdrake/neurovue beside NeuroFlow, or set NEUROFLOW_UI_APP_NEUROVUE to the checkout.

failures.meaning: Neither bids_dir nor volumes gave a readable NIfTI volume, or match filtered them all out.
failures.remedy: Check the paths and the match glob.
